name: adaptations_read
description: Use when a learned or adjusted module value may explain the symptom: idle speed offset, EGR base duty and similar adaptation channels.
instructions: Call read_adaptations {} once: it reads up to 10 of this car's adaptation channels reachable on this link.
Each line is "<name> (<module>): <value> <unit> raw <hex>"; compare the value with what the symptom suggests (e.g. a raised idle offset with a high idle).
This phase reads only; to change a value the owner uses the Adaptations / Coding screens. Never tell the owner the agent changed or will change a value.
Values marked unconfirmed come from channels not yet checked on this car: quote them as indicative and say so.
interpret: Adaptation channels and their scaling are manufacturer-specific and come from this car's profile; the raw bytes are what the module returned.

"not readable without the adaptation session; open Adaptations" means the K-line module answers that channel only inside its adaptation session, which the agent never opens: it is not a fault. Suggest the Adaptations screen if the value matters.
"no answer" means the module did not return that channel (not supported, or it is asleep): it is not a fault.
A value outside the range the symptom suggests is a lead, not proof: an unconfirmed value never justifies an urgent verdict, and a change is the owner's decision on the Adaptations screen.
